rationale.collapsed-section: CHOSEN. Kernel composite 8.622, margin 3.382, high confidence. A collapsed 'Pace and priority' section composed from the shared Surface primitive, alongside the existing Work / Context / Decisions sections. Lowest human_cognitive_load of the three (0.2): closed by default, so the room's first viewport is unchanged and default-visible words do not grow, while still answering 'why is this coworker behaving like this' on demand.
rationale.always-visible-band: REJECTED. Kernel composite 5.240. A permanent band pinned to every room scores worst on human_cognitive_load (0.8) — the room already carries participants, work, context, decisions, cycles and receipts, so a always-on band taxes every visit to serve a question most visits do not ask. Scores negative against 'Preserve the model; disclose complexity progressively'.
rationale.separate-page: REJECTED. Kernel composite 4.899. Worst operator_effort (0.75) and slowest speed_to_value (0.2) — a navigation hop to answer a question asked while looking at the room, plus a new route to keep coherent. The rich layer-by-layer provenance it would host stays scoped to BI-4EB2F1D0.
